alert.name: Windows Logs Canary Absence
alert.description: Windows canary logs missing from pipeline. Expected canary logs every 5 minutes from Windows Event Log and file log sources, but none received in last 10 minutes. Current value: {{$value}} canary logs in last 10 minutes. Threshold: {{$threshold}} (minimum expected).

logsQuery.query: (log.source = 'windows_event_log' AND body contains 'windows-canary') OR (log.file.path contains 'windows-canary-test.log' AND body contains 'windows-canary')
